stages.name: King's Pit
stages.answers: Stun (Colossusbane, Frostbow III), Frost, Breakers in burst windows; Scout block, Strong-vs-Fast Striker (Lancer, Snowpup), Slow; Anti-air (Sparrow, Skyreaver), Strong-vs-Flying Rangers (Skyhook, Harpooner); Fast Strikers (Blizzardfang), Reach (Longshot), Rally; Area (Mortar, Catapult), Reach
stages.hint: Colossals ignore knockback until their last segments. Stun the wind-up and burst.

stages.name: Compactor, Hardened and Hasty

stages.hint: Swarms overwhelm single-target units. Bring Area damage.
